_about: Hand-curated access facts the open data doesn't cover. Every entry with "verify": true needs Steve (or someone who rides there) to check it. "sledOK": true on a winter closure makes the closed road a snowmobile route. A trailhead "note" is shown beside every route that starts there. Coordinates marked "snap" are moved to the highest point within 1.5 km (for lift tops) or the nearest road cell (for trailheads) when the pipeline runs.

liftGates.name: Blackcomb Glacier backcountry gate (Spearhead Traverse start)
liftGates.note: Lift ticket or pass needed, and the resort's backcountry access rules apply. Ride time from the village is an estimate.

liftGates.name: Whistler Peak (Musical Bumps / Flute access)
liftGates.note: Lift ticket or pass needed, and the resort's backcountry access rules apply. Ride time from the village is an estimate.

trailheads.name: Diamond Head parking lot (Garibaldi Park Road, Squamish)
trailheads.note: Chains are mandatory on the road up to the Diamond Head lot in winter.
trailheads.checked: Steve, 2026-11-10: road open to the lot; chains mandatory in winter

trailheads.name: Mt Baker Ski Area upper lot (Heather Meadows)
trailheads.note: Winter road ends here. Backcountry starts at the ski area boundary; the ski area itself is excluded.

winterRoadClosures.name: SR 20 North Cascades Highway winter closure (approx. Ross Dam trailhead MP 134 to Silver Star gate MP 171)
winterRoadClosures.note: Closed to cars roughly November to April. Snowmobiles can use the closed highway. Washington Pass and Rainy Pass are a long trip from the gates in winter.
winterRoadClosures.checked: Steve, 2026-11-10: snowmobiling the closed SR 20 is legal

winterRoadClosures.name: Mt Baker Highway beyond the ski area (road to Artist Point)
winterRoadClosures.note: Not plowed past the upper ski area lot in winter.

permitsAndClosures.name: Kootenay Pass (Highway 3) avalanche control
permitsAndClosures.text: Highway 3 over Kootenay Pass closes for avalanche control, sometimes with little notice, and parking and skiing near the highway can be restricted during control work. Check DriveBC before you go.
